Chapter 1113: 33: Incredible Improvement (Requesting Subscription)

Chapter 1113: Chapter 33: Incredible Improvement (Requesting Subscription)

Within the Taiyin Primordial Spirit’s inner cosmos.

Taiyin Energy pervades, this is a universe based on the Taiyin Rule, with cold and chill as its main theme.

Normally speaking.

Path Splitting Realm experts have already nurtured an inner universe.

Its internal rules are perfected and balanced, independent of the real universe.

But in reality, all inner universes that are nurtured are based on the insights into their own realm by Path Splitting Realm experts.

And each Path Splitting Realm expert has different insights into the rules.

Each has its own focus.

This influences the inner universe.

The Taiyin Primordial Spirit’s inner universe is just like this.

Clearly focused on Taiyin.

The Taiyang Divine Spirit is the same, focused on Taiyang.

As for the true self? The fusion of Taiyin and Taiyang, transforming into Taiji, deriving all things, almost without a particular focus.

The inner universe of the true self is most similar to the real universe, with myriad rules operating in balance.

And at this moment.

In the endlessly cold and chilly Taiyin Universe.

A wisp of flame burns quickly, everything illuminated by the firelight becomes its domain.

Light and heat continuously spread, dispelling the cold and chill.

The entire Taiyin Universe is faintly beginning to undergo some inexplicable transformation.

“This transformation?”

“The Origin Source of the Taiyin Universe and the Origin of the Fierce Sun seem to form a balance?”

Lin Yuan’s expression slightly changed.

The balance between Taiyin and Taiyang can easily form, this is one of the two great foundations of Lin Yuan’s Taiji Dao.

But Taiyin and Fierce Sun?

What the Taiyang and Fierce Sun represent are fundamentally different grand Dao, though both belong to ‘Yang’ attributes, they are entirely two different directions.

However, at this moment, within the Taiyin Universe, the omnipresent Taiyin Origin is transforming with the Origin of the Fierce Sun, forming a more perfect cycle.

And this cycle caused the structure of the Taiyin Universe to subtly undergo a fundamental metamorphosis, and its stability and the concentration of the origin suddenly soared by a large margin.

“The Origin of the Fierce Sun in the Fierce Sun Opens the Heavens Divine Ability is condensed by me, so the world it finally opens is also my world.”

“But the Taiyin Universe is also nurtured by me, essentially also my world.”

“Therefore, the transformation of the Taiyin Universe by the Origin of the Fierce Sun is very smooth, with virtually no rejection.”

Lin Yuan watched the firelight illuminated by the Origin of the Fierce Sun spreading and expanding in the Taiyin Universe, with a look of contemplation.

The Physical Body Divine Ability ‘Fierce Sun Opens the Heavens’ is a divine ability that consumes a tremendous amount, and this Lin Yuan was very sure of when he first awakened this divine ability.

With his strength, even if he exhausts his Origin, he couldn’t maintain this divine ability for long.

The root reason lies in the essence of ‘Fierce Sun Opens the Heavens,’ which forcibly transforms the ownership of the surrounding world into Lin Yuan’s world.

The resulting ‘resistance’ and ‘rejection’ are the fundamental reasons for the consumption.

However, within the Taiyin Universe, the surrounding world is originally Lin Yuan’s, and as Fierce Sun Opens the Heavens continuously opened up the world, there was basically no ‘resistance’ or ‘rejection.’

So Lin Yuan even felt that, as long as he wished, this Origin of the Fierce Sun could persist indefinitely.

“Fusion, the Origin of the Fierce Sun is fusing with the Taiyin Universe.”

Lin Yuan observed carefully, detecting this tendency.

That is, the Origin of the Fierce Sun itself is faintly beginning to integrate into the Taiyin Universe.

The deeper the fusion, the higher the completeness of the cycle between the Origin of the Fierce Sun and the Taiyin Universe, and the greater the enhancement to the entire universe.

“So marvelous.”

As the creator of the universe, Lin Yuan felt incredibly clear about the numerous changes and transformations occurring during the fusion of the Origin of the Fierce Sun and the Taiyin Universe.

“The essence of the Origin of the Fierce Sun merging with the Taiyin Universe is that the Taiyin Universe has also cultivated ‘Infinite Void,’ and so it can bear the Origin of the Fierce Sun.”

Lin Yuan thought to himself.

Initially, he was condensing the Origin of the Fierce Sun within the cosmos of his incarnation.

But without any surprises, the inner universe of the incarnation directly collapsed, unable to contain the power of the Origin of the Fierce Sun.

The Origin of the Fierce Sun comes from the Physical Body Divine Ability Fierce Sun Opens the Heavens, and this divine ability is a form of power and ability from the Ancestor of Fierce Sun in the source world.

Only by the Infinite Void created by the same Thirteenth Layer existence, can reach the threshold to contain the Origin of the Fierce Sun.

For example, wanting to use a piece of tofu to hold an iron needle results in the needle piercing through the tofu.

But if an iron box is used to hold the needle, naturally, there’s no problem.

The Taiyin Universe, which has cultivated ‘Infinite Void,’ is like the iron box, qualified to bear the iron needle.

“Hm?”

While Lin Yuan was observing the changes in the Taiyin Universe, he was also constantly maintaining the Origin of the Fierce Sun.

Suddenly, as the Origin of the Fierce Sun burned fiercely and fused with the Taiyin Universe’s origin, the balance was slightly broken.

In an instant, the Taiyin Universe began collapsing.

“The fusion failed?”

Seeing this scene, Lin Yuan was not surprised.

Even when Taiyin and Taiyang, which were naturally the same source, were first merged by Lin Yuan, maintaining the balance was often unsustainable, causing mutual collapse.

Much less Taiyin and Fierce Sun?

“In fact, Taiyin and Fierce Sun, it’s not a fusion but a devour, the Taiyin Universe’s Origin is slowly devouring the Origin of the Fierce Sun.”

Lin Yuan’s mind stirred, and a new Taiyin Primordial Spirit was condensed.

Compared with the avatars of other Thirteenth Layer experts, which require a huge mental and effort cost to cultivate, Lin Yuan’s two Primordial Spirits are much simpler.

Re-condensing doesn’t take much time at all.

This is also one of the advantages of the Martial Arts Evolution Road, with endless paths in Chaos Void, each having its own strengths and weaknesses.

But as in the Martial Arts Evolution Road, being able to easily condense Primordial Spirits is rare.
